scope: Selected primary sources; not an exhaustive collection of all known or speculative theories.

sources.title: First Sagittarius A* EHT Results: Calibrated Data, 2022-D02-01
sources.used_for: Provenance, schema and pinned file metadata. Optional local full download. The build inspected a five-record parser excerpt, not the complete measurement corpus.

sources.title: First Sagittarius A* EHT Results I
sources.used_for: Reported ring diameter and uncertainty of azimuthal brightness. Does not establish three separate persistent objects.

sources.title: First Sagittarius A* EHT Results III: Imaging
sources.used_for: Sparse interferometric sampling, source variability, scattering, ensemble of reconstructions.

sources.title: EHT 2022-D02-02 imaging pipelines
sources.used_for: Original pipeline reference. Not installed or reproduced by this small standalone lab.

sources.title: Re-analysis of Data from Milky Way Central Supermassive Black Hole Observations
sources.used_for: An alternative elongated reconstruction; read together with EHT's methodological response. Not evidence for a portal.

sources.title: Response to An Independent Analysis of EHTC Imaging of Sgr A* by Miyoshi et al. 2024
sources.used_for: Variability, calibration bias and image ensembles. The disagreement is not resolved by the toy diagnostic in this lab.

sources.title: Silhouettes of wormholes traversed for radiation
sources.used_for: Explicit Ellis metric and b<q versus b>q branch structure; multiple images of sources from the second asymptotic region. Our equations and implementation are independently derived, not the authors' code.

sources.title: Image of another universe being observed through a wormhole throat
sources.used_for: Direct literature connection for the user's proposed line of sight; theoretical, not observational confirmation.

sources.title: Visualizing Interstellar's Wormhole
sources.used_for: Backward ray maps from a camera to two celestial spheres. This package uses Ellis, not the film's three-parameter metric.

sources.title: EHT Sagittarius A* Polarized Data, 2024-D02-01
sources.used_for: Catalogued as a separate future constraint, not downloaded or analyzed here. White polarization lines are not material filaments.

sources.title: EHT Data Products
sources.used_for: Release inventory checked. This lab deliberately pins a selected 2017 product rather than claiming to use every release.

user_hypotheses.implemented: Three independent Gaussian emission regions with configurable weights and orientation
user_hypotheses.not_implemented: No physical fusion mechanism, coupling or handshake dynamics; no material identification

user_hypotheses.content: Looking through the center into another region
user_hypotheses.implemented: A second freely chosen synthetic celestial sphere in an explicitly assumed Ellis metric
user_hypotheses.not_implemented: No identification with Sgr A*, no known access key, no claim of observed planets, people or universes
